svg.title: Four finished illusions on different skin tones, all kept outside the eye area. Porcelain crack, light skin: cracks run from the forehead down over the temple, around the outside of the eye. Galaxy zipper, brown skin: a short zipper on the cheek opens onto a starry galaxy. Stitched seam, fair skin: a row of stitches curves across the forehead. Peeled skin, tan skin: a small torn patch on the cheek is curled back to show green dragon scales.
